note: The nine cards of the first version 2 library (package I9) on 2 normal pages, with the detail pages of the lights that do more than turn on and off (the porch lamp has none). Made by tests/cards_fixture.py in apollo_tab: 'dashboard' and 'facts' are what Home Assistant converts; 'layout' is the layout v2 for a tablet with the caps of contract.json 'engine_caps', 'v1' the layout v1 for a tablet with engine 0.1.0 (the caps of the .v1 meta file). 'devices' is what Home Assistant knows of each device, from which 'facts' are made.
